verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean... off San Diego'; R2: 'splashdown... off the coast of San Diego'; R3: 'splashed down off the coast of San Diego'; R4: 'off the coast of San Diego, California'; R5/R6/R7/R8: similar phrasing for Pacific off San Diego splashdown.
